ja.title: Trastuzumab rezetecanの体重換算投与をADCとペイロードの両方で確かめる
ja.seo_title: Trastuzumab rezetecanの体重と曝露 | Daiki Kumakura
ja.summary: 公表モデルと補足コードから、体重別のADC・遊離ペイロード曝露を計算。固定量・べき乗補正・上限付き投与を比較し、係数の不確実性と体重以外に残る影響を整理する。

en.title: Trastuzumab rezetecan weight dosing across ADC and payload exposure
en.summary: A public ADC/payload model separates weight effects, residual variability and covariate effects without selecting a clinical dose.
en.seo_title: Trastuzumab rezetecan weight dosing and payload AUC
en.seo_description: A public ADC/payload model separates weight effects, residual variability and covariate effects without selecting a clinical dose.

english.title: Trastuzumab rezetecan weight dosing across ADC and payload exposure
english.summary: Public two-analyte PK supports conditional comparisons of weight-based, fixed, power and capped dosing. Similar AUC weight slopes do not establish improved clinical benefit or control other covariates.
